import bpy, os, json, pathlib, subprocess, textwrap
expected=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=expected: raise RuntimeError(f'ABORTADO arquivo errado {bpy.data.filepath!r}')
work=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work')
npz=work/'terrain_2017_candidate.npz'
if not npz.exists(): raise RuntimeError('candidato terrain_2017_candidate.npz ausente')
parent=bpy.data.collections.get('01 WORLD | ELEVADOR LACERDA | blockout v4')
low=bpy.data.collections.get('D | ESTACAO CIDADE BAIXA | blockout v1')
terrain=bpy.data.objects.get('WORLD | TERRENO MASTER | blockout')
if not parent or not low or not terrain: raise RuntimeError('anchors/terreno master ausentes')
tower=next((o for o in parent.objects if 'torre documental' in o.name.lower() and o.type=='MESH'),None)
hall=next((o for o in parent.objects if 'hall piso terreo marcador' in o.name.lower() and o.type=='MESH'),None)
low_floor=next((o for o in low.objects if 'piso saguão' in o.name.lower() and o.type=='MESH'),None)
if not tower or not hall or not low_floor: raise RuntimeError('anchors-chave ausentes')
anchors=[]
for label,o in [('TOWER',tower),('UPPER_HALL',hall),('LOWER_STATION',low_floor)]:
    anchors.append({'label':label,'x':float(o.location.x),'y':float(o.location.y),'z':float(o.location.z)})
print('ANCHORS='+json.dumps(anchors))
print('TERRAIN_MASTER',terrain.name,'TYPE',terrain.type,'VERTS',len(terrain.data.vertices) if terrain.type=='MESH' else None,'LOC',tuple(round(v,4) for v in terrain.location),'DIMS',tuple(round(v,4) for v in terrain.dimensions))
py=r'C:\mcp-blender\.venv-geo\Scripts\python.exe'
script=work/'sample_candidate_alignment.py'
script.write_text(r'''
import numpy as np, json, sys
d=np.load(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work\terrain_2017_candidate.npz')
v=d['verts']
a=json.loads(sys.argv[1])
pts=v.reshape(-1,3)
for q in a:
    dd=(pts[:,0]-q['x'])**2+(pts[:,1]-q['y'])**2
    i=int(np.argmin(dd)); p=pts[i]
    print(q['label'], 'MODEL_Z',round(q['z'],4),'TERRAIN_Z',round(float(p[2]),4),'DZ_TERRAIN_MINUS_MODEL',round(float(p[2])-q['z'],4),'XY_DIST',round(float(dd[i]**0.5),4),'GRID_XY',round(float(p[0]),4),round(float(p[1]),4))
''',encoding='utf-8')
r=subprocess.run([py,str(script),json.dumps(anchors)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
print('SAMPLE_RC',r.returncode)
print(r.stdout)
print(r.stderr)
if r.returncode: raise RuntimeError('falha amostrando candidato')
print('VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_INSPECT_OK')
